chapter.verse: Tua hi a, amaute a vekpi-un kithawi-in Pilate' mai-ah Jesu paipih uh hi.

Tua ciangin Jesu mawhzon ding kipan uh a, "Hih mipa, ko minamte lamkhial hong tunpih, Caesar' tungah siah ka piak ding uh hong kham, amahmah kumpi khat ahi Khris ka hi, a cih ka thei uh hi," ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Pilate in Jesu' kiangah, "Nang Jew Kumpi na hi hiam?" ci-in dong hi. Jesu in, "Ahi bangin na gen hi," ci-in dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Pilate in siampi liante leh mihonpi' kiangah, "Hih mipa' tungah mawhsak nading khialhna ka mu kei hi," ci hi.
Ahih hangin amaute uang semsem uh a, "Amah in Galilee pan hih mun dong Judea gam mun citeng ah thu hilhcianin mite sosuah hi," ci uh hi.
Hih thu Pilate in a zak ciangin tua mipa Galilee mi ahih leh ahihloh dong hi.
Jesu pen Herod' ukna huam sunga mi cih a theih ciangin Pilate in tua hun laitaka Jerusalem khua-a om Herod' kiangah Jesu puak hi.
Herod in Jesu' thu za ngei khin, a mi zong a muhnop sawt khin ahih manin Jesu a muh ciangin nuam mahmah a, kihilna lim kimkhat hong bawl dingin zong lamen hi.
Tua hangin Herod in sauveipi thu dong a, ahih hangin Jesu in bangmah dawng lo hi.
A gei-a tu siampi liante leh laisiamte in Jesu nakpi-in mawhpaih uh hi.
Tua banah Herod leh ama' galkapte in Jesu neubawlin zahpih uh hi. Tua ciangin Herod in puansilh thupia tawh Jesu zemin Pilate' kiang puakkik hi.
Tua ni mahin Herod leh Pilate, lawmta khat suak uh hi. A hang pen tua ma-in amaute gel khatlekhat a kigalneih uh ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Pilate in siampi liante, uliante leh mipite samkhawmin

amaute' kiangah, "Note in hih mipa, mite a lampialsak dan khatin kei' kiang nong paipih uh hi. En un, note' mai-ah amah ka dottel khit ciangin amah na mawhsak thute uh khat beek ama' tung ka mu kei hi.
Herod in zong a muh om lo ahih manin ei' kiang hong puakkik ahi hi. En un, amah in sihna a thuaktaak khialhna thu khat zong bawl lo hi.
Tua ahih manin amah thuhilhin ka khah ding hi," ci hi.
(Tu-in Pilate pen pawi hun sungin tua mite' ading mi khat a khahkhiat ding ahi hi.)b
Ahih hangin mihonpi awng ngeingei uh a, "Hih mipa hemkhia lel inla ko' kiangah Barabbas hong khahkhia in!" ci uh hi.
(Barabbas cih pen khuapi sungpan hong kipan kumpi lehdona thu leh tualthahna thu hangin thong sunga kikhum khat ahi hi).
Pilate in Jesu khah nuam ahih manin mihonpi khatvei hopihpha hi.
Ahih hangin amaute awng suaksuak uh a, "Khailum in, amah khailum in!" ci uh hi.

Pilate in amaute' kiangah a thumveina dingin, "Bang hang hiam? Hih mipa in bang thusia bawl ahi hiam? Ama' tungah sihna a thuaktaak khialhna khat zong ka mu kei hi. Tua ahih manin amah thuhilhin ka khah ding hi," ci hi.
Ahih hangin amaute uang semsem uh a, Jesu khailup dingin nakpi kiko uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute' awging kizel hi.
Tua hangin Pilate in zong amaute' ngetna piak dingin khensat hi.
Tua ciangin amau' ngetpa ahi, kumpi lehdona leh tualthahna thu tawh thong sunga kikhum mipa khahkhia a, Jesu ahihleh mihonpi' deihna zui-in amaute' kiangah ap hi.
Amaute in Jesu a paikhiatpih laitak, khualam pana hong pai Cyrene khuami Simon lammat uh a, ama' tungah singlamteh suanin Jesu' nungah zuisak uh hi.
Tua ciangin mihonpi tampitak leh dahna tawh Jesu a tamlawh numei tampitak in Jesu zui uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu kihei-in amaute' kiangah hih bangin ci hi: "Jerusalem tanute aw, kei hong kah kei unla noleno leh na tate uh kahzaw un.
A hang pen, en un, mite in, 'Ta neilo numei, nau a paai ngeilo naubu, a zu kitep ngeilo nawibu, thuphangah ahi hi!' a cih hunte hong tung ta ding hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in mualte kiangah, 'Kote hong cipnelh un,' ci-in mualbote kiangah, 'Kote hong vuk un,' ci ding uh hi.
A hang pen sing a hin laitak hih thute bawl uh ahihleh sing a keu ciangin bang teng hong piang ding hiam?"
Jesu tawh thahkhop dingin khutkhial migilo a dang nih zong kipaipih hi.
Misi Luguhd a kicihna mun a tun uh ciangin singlamteh tungah Jesu khai uh a, khutkhial migilote zong a taklam ah khat, a veilam ah khat, khai uh hi.
(Jesu in, "Pa aw, amaute in a hih uh bang hiam cih thei lo uh ahih manin a mawhna uh na maisak in," ci hi.)e Tua ciangin amaute in suangtang aisanna tawh ama' puansilhte hawm uh hi.
Mite zong tua lai-ah dingin en uh hi. Uliante ahihleh Jesu nehpik uh a, "Amah in midangte honkhia hi; tu-in Pasian' Teelpa Khris ahihleh amahmah kihonkhia ta hen!" ci uh hi.
Galkapte zong hong pai-in zahpihna tawh lengtui thuk pia uh a,
"Jew Kumpi na hihleh nangmahmah kihonkhia in!" ci uh hi.
Ama' lutang tungsan ah, "Hih pen Jew Mite' Kumpi ahi hi," cih laisuan khat om hi.
Singlamteh tunga kikhai khutkhial migilote lakah khat in Jesu zahko-in, "Nang Khris hilo na hi hiam? Nangmahmah kihonkhia inla ko zong hong honkhia in," ci hi.
Ahih hangin a khatpa in tua mipa taai a, "Nang zong mawhsak thukhenna mah a tuakkha hinapi-in Pasian kihta lo na hi hiam?
Ei pen i gamtatna tawh kituakin a ngah i hih manin a dik a maan ahi hi. Ahi zongin hih mipa ahihleh khialhna bangmah bawl lo hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu' kiangah, "Jesu aw, na kumpigam sung na pai ciangin kei hong phawk in," ci hi.
Jesu in zong, "Maantak kong cihin ah tuniin paradiseg ah kei tawh na omkhawm ding hi," ci hi.
Tua hun pen sunkim nai sawmlenih sat kuan hi a, tua gam bup ah sunnung nai thum ciangdong khimzing hi.
Tua hun sung ni taang lo hi. Biakinnpi sunga inndei puanpij zong phel nih kisuah hi.
Tua ciangin awging lianpi tawh Jesu kiko a, "Pa aw, nangma' khut sungah ka kha kong ap hi," ci hi. A cih khit ciangin a hu tawpna sangkhia hi.
Galkap za-uk bupa in thupiang teng a muh ciangin Pasian phat a, "Hih mipa midik hi taktak hi," ci hi.
Hih thupiang en dinga kikaikhawm mihonpi khempeuh in thupiang teng a muh uh ciangin dahna tawh dip humsa-in ciah uh hi.
Galilee pan Jesu a zui a meltheihte leh numeite zong a vekun a gamla mun khat ah ding uh a, hih thupiang teng mu uh hi.
Tu-in Sanhedrin ulian lakah Joseph a kici mihoih midik khat om hi.
Amah pen Judah gam Arimathea khua pan hi a, Pasian' kumpigam a lamen khat ahi hi. Sanhedrin uliante' thukhenna leh nasepna amah thukim lo hi.
Pilate mangpa' kiangah amah pai-in Jesu' luang ngen hi.
Tua ciangin a luang domkhiasukin puannel dialpi khat tawh tun a, kuamah a kisial nailohna suang kikhuak hankhuk sung khat ah sial hi.
Tua ni pen Kiginnik hi a, Sabbath tung kuanta hi.
Galilee pan Jesu tawh a tonkhawm numeite in zui uh a, hankhuk leh Jesu' luang kisialzia va mu uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute ciahin zanamtui leh nilhthaute bawlkhol uh hi.
